items.prompt: After cloning a repo with submodules, empty submodule folders usually mean…
choices: You still need git submodule update --init --recursive
The submodule was deleted from GitHub
items.explain: A plain clone records gitlinks but does not populate submodule working trees until init.

items.prompt: Detached HEAD inside a submodule at a pinned SHA is normal.
items.explain: The parent pins a specific commit; checkout is detached until you switch a branch intentionally.

items.prompt: To bump a submodule version for teammates, you must…
choices: Commit the updated gitlink in the parent repo
Only edit files locally without any commit
Force-push main on the parent only
items.explain: The parent repo stores the pin; others see the new SHA only after that commit.

items.prompt: To clone and fetch submodules in one step, use…
items.explain: --recurse-submodules runs init/update during clone—handy for CI and fresh checkouts.
